case_title: MOHD. HUSSAIN @ JULFIKAR ALI v. THE STATE (GOVT. OF NCT) DELHI
statutory_provisions: IPC s.302, s.307; Explosive Substances Act s.3, s.4(b)
aggravating_circumstances: Death of four persons, injury to twenty-four persons, public transport bus
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s.302/307 IPC and s.3 of Explosive Substances Act, sentenced to death
neutral_facts: The accused was prosecuted for planting a bomb in a public transport bus, which resulted in the death of four persons and injury to twenty-four persons. The prosecution presented evidence including witness statements and medical reports. The trial court convicted the accused of murder and sentenced him to death. The High Court confirmed the conviction and sentence. The accused was denied the assistance of a legal counsel during the trial, leading to a retrial being ordered.
